name: The Order Protocol
subtitle: Structure that holds when you can't -- and why discipline was never going to.
toc_note: Read it with a pen. Part V is a build, not a read: give it a Saturday morning. Part VII takes four questions a day.
back_line: Discipline is a bridge, not a foundation. You can't build a life on it.
back_sub: If you keep failing at things you genuinely want to do, you don't need more willpower. You need architecture: a life designed so the right thing is the easy thing. This is how to build it.
